question.en: What if he shot at the far post?
What if he shot at the near post?

lines.text: If N. Varnhall had gone for the near post, H. Talvisto would have saved it.
Going for the near post had a 0.26 chance of a goal; the far post had 0.79.
如果N. Varnhall打近角，会被H. Talvisto扑出。
打近角的进球概率是0.26，打远角是0.79。
That option would have been worth 0.78 less in expected threat than what he did.
这个选择比他实际的选择少0.78的预期威胁（xT）。
